Repository: cross-platform dotfiles (macOS/Linux/WSL); tiered shell, tmux, Neovim. Main CLI: `bin/dot`; libraries: `lib/cli/` (`core.sh`, `ai.sh`, `security.sh`, `project.sh`, `testing.sh`). Tools/profiles: `config/tools.yaml`; profiles: minimal, standard, full, ai_focused. Plugins: `plugins/core/`, `plugins/community/`, `plugins/local/`.

Commands:
```
./install.sh install standard
./install.sh install minimal     # Essential tools only
./install.sh install full        # Complete setup with AI tools
./install.sh install ai_focused  # AI-enhanced development
./install.sh --dry-run install standard
./install.sh link
dot setup
dot check
dot update
dot reload
dot project init
dot ai review
dot security scan
dot metrics dashboard
dot plugin list
dot migrate status
./tests/test_runner.sh
dot test quick
./tests/test_runner.sh --category infrastructure
find . -name "*.sh" -exec shellcheck {} \;
find . -name "*.yaml" -o -name "*.yml" | xargs yamllint
dot doctor
dot test run
perf-status
perf-bench
perf-quick
```

Add tools: edit `config/tools.yaml`; add to essential, development, or optional; test with `./install.sh --dry-run install standard`; run `./tests/test_runner.sh`. Plugins: copy `plugins/local/hello-world/`; implement required functions in `lib/core.sh`; define metadata in `plugin.yaml`; test with `dot plugin install <plugin-name>`.

1. Always run the full test suite: `./tests/test_runner.sh`
2. Test specific components: `dot test <component>`
3. Validate linting: shellcheck and yamllint
4. Check cross-platform compatibility

All secrets handled through `dot secret` commands. GPG/SSH management automated; gitleaks scanning and pre-commit hooks.

Configs: `config/nvim/init.lua`, `config/nvim/lua/core/`, `config/nvim/lua/tiers/`, `config/nvim/lua/languages/`, `config/tmux/tmux.conf`, `config/tmux/core.conf`, `config/zsh/`, `config/gitconfig`, `config/shellcheckrc`, `config/yamllint.yml`. Entry points/docs: `install.sh`, `scripts/bootstrap.sh`, `tests/test_runner.sh`, `README.md`, `docs/`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `docs/technical-debt.md`.
